General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: Under flexible exchange rate system, the exchange rate is determined
options: predominantly by  market mechanism
by the Central Bank
as a weighted index of a group of currencies
by the World Trade Organization
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (a)  A flexible exchange rate system is a kind of a monetary system which allows the exchange rate to be regulated by supply and demand in relation to other currencies. 237 Economics

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: Which one of the following is not correct in the context of industrial clusters development in India?
options: Industrial clusters play an important role for the MSME participants in their inclusiveness, technology absorption and efficiency improvement
Industrial clusters are visible in traditional handloom, handicrafts and modern SME
Industrial cluster programmes in India are administered by various ministries
Industrial clusters lead to promotion of monopoly in the market
General Knowledge 2015-II.answer: Industrial cluster programmes in India are administered by various ministries
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (c)  Industrial clusters development has an objective to support the sustainability and growth of small and medium enterprises in India. This scheme is governed and administered by the Ministry of micro, small and medium enterprises.

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: Private investment in Indian agriculture is mostly on labour- saving mechanization. This could be a response to
options: rising productivity of agricultural sector
rising inequality in agriculture
rising wages and tighter labour market
debt write-off by the Government
General Knowledge 2015-II.answer: rising wages and tighter labour market
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (c)  The entry of Private investment in Indian agriculture would be responsible for rising wages and tightening labour market due to labour saving mechanism.

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: Which one of the following is the major source of gross tax revenue (GTR) for the Government of India?
options: Income tax
Corporation tax
Customs duty
Service tax
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (b)  Corporation tax in India is the major source of Gross Tax Revenue (GTR) for the Government of India. It has great tax collection in comparison to income tax, custom duty and service tax.

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: Which of the following statements in the context of income- environment relationship is /are correct?  (1) Pollution trends tend to follow an inverse-U shaped relationship across different stages of economic development. (2) In the beginning stage, pollution increases due to urbanization and industrialization. (3) In the later stage, pollution declines due to structural changes towards services sector. Select the correct answer using the code given below.
options: 1 only
1 and 2 only
1, 2 and 3
2 and 3 only
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (c)  Pollution trends show inverse relationship with economic development. In early stage, pollution increases due to urbanization and industrialization. At last, pollution declines due to structural changes towards service sector.

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: Which one of the following represents a progressive tax structure?
options: Tax rate is the same across all incomes
Tax rate increases as income increases
Tax rate decreases as income increases
Each household pays equal amount of tax
General Knowledge 2015-II.answer: Tax rate increases as income increases
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (b)  Progressive tax structure means increase in tax rate with increase in taxable amount. The word-progressive denotes a progress from low to high.

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: Which one of the following is an example of a 'natural monopoly'?
options: Indian Airlines
Delhi Jal Board
Delhi Transport Corporation
Steel Authority of India
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (b)  When monopoly is arisen due to climatic, environmental and any natural factors in a particular area or in any country, known as Natural monopoly. Example of Natural monopolies include monopoly of South Africa on gold and diamond mining and oil production by Arabic nation.

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: What is meant by price discrimination?
options: Increase in price of a commodity over time
A situation where the same product is sold to different consumers for different prices
Subsidization of a product by the Government to sell it at a lower price
General decrease in price of a commodity over time
General Knowledge 2015-II.answer: A situation where the same product is sold to different consumers for different prices
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (b)  When different consumers pay different prices for the same product, this situation is known as price discrimination.

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: What is meant by 'Public Good'?
options: A commodity produced by the Government
A commodity whose benefits are indivisibly spread among the entire community
A Government scheme that benefits the poor households
Any commodity that is very popular among general public
General Knowledge 2015-II.answer: A commodity whose benefits are indivisibly spread among the entire community
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (b)  Public good means a commodity or service which is given without profit to everyone in a society by government or any organisation.

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: Which of the following factors led to  a decline in inflation rate in India during 2014-2015?
General Knowledge 2015-II.explanation: (a)  Government strict measures to control food inflation and persistent decline in crude prices results in  declining trend in inflation during 2014-15.

General Knowledge 2015-II.subject: General Knowledge
General Knowledge 2015-II.question: Which one of the following statements about the Companies Act, 2013 is not correct?
options: The Act regulates the corporate sector to make it accountable.
It provides for Corporate Social Responsibility.
It provides more opportunities for new entrepreneurs.
It enables wide application of Information Technology.
General Knowledge 2015-II.answer: It provides more opportunities for new entrepreneurs.
